findings.claim: The change does not satisfy the requirement that archiving leave `openspec list` showing only open changes.
findings.evidence: Spec requirement says the completed analysis change SHALL be archived "so that `openspec list` shows only open changes", but the task note states: "`openspec list` still shows the PARENT phase’s two changes, `karpathy-progress-recorder` and `okf-v02-via-pk`, as `✓ Complete` but unarchived."
findings.suggested_fix: Archive the completed changes still shown by `openspec list`, or amend the spec before claiming this requirement complete.

findings.claim: The implementation cannot detect when `versions.toml` omits a container image the pack starts.
findings.evidence: The spec requires `versions.toml` to name "every container image the pack starts", but `compareToTree` only iterates `Object.entries(parsed.images ?? {})` and has no injected compose/service inventory to compare against.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an injected list of expected images/services from the tree and report any started image missing from `[images]`.

findings.claim: The submodule completeness check enforces all gitlinks in the repository instead of only submodules under `tools/`.
findings.evidence: The spec says `versions.toml` SHALL name "every submodule under `tools/`", but `compareToTree` reports every path returned by `listGitlinks()` that is absent from `[submodules]`, and `rules/test/versions-toml.test.mjs` supplies all `git ls-tree -r HEAD` gitlinks without filtering to `tools/`.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter completeness checks to paths equal to or below `tools/`, or rename/spec the requirement if all repository gitlinks are intended.

findings.claim: Duplicate keys are silently overwritten instead of rejected, allowing an invalid TOML authority to mask a pin.
findings.evidence: `parseVersionsToml` assigns `parsed[table][name] = ...` without checking whether `name` already exists; docs state this is a TOML subset and that unsupported or unsafe constructs should raise rather than silently misread.
findings.suggested_fix: Before assignment, reject duplicate keys in a table with a `versions.toml` parse error.
